title: Abandoned content export republishes field-pair cache records
fault_primitive: Detached content export publishes JSON field-pair records into native post-object and creator-ID cache slots
incident_class: Abandoned cache format migration with competing writers and delayed reconciliation
symptoms: Compose requests fail with stoul errors and timeline reads return HTTP 500 with a native JSON object/array type error, followed by RPC capacity loss and low throughput; all application pods remain Running and Ready. Empty home feeds can still succeed.
